categories.main_business_segments: Anhui Tongyuan Environment Energy Saving Co., Ltd. specializes in ecological environment comprehensive remediation, including solid waste pollution control and resource utilization, sewage and water environment comprehensive treatment, soil and groundwater remediation, and photovoltaic energy. The company provides integrated environmental solutions encompassing design, equipment manufacturing, project construction, and operation services primarily for local governments and large enterprises.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed proprietary core technologies such as solid waste pollution barrier and remediation systems, high-dry dehydration and carbonization of sludge, integrated treatment of river and lake sediments, 'mud-film symbiosis' integrated modular rural sewage treatment systems, soil steam thermal desorption, and multiphase extraction for groundwater. It also focuses on advanced wastewater treatment technologies including deep treatment of industrial fluorine-containing wastewater and innovative CO2 capture and conversion technologies into high-value chemicals and fuels.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include local government departments and their subordinate units, large enterprises, and industrial clients. The company serves markets in solid waste landfill remediation, municipal and industrial wastewater treatment, rural sewage ecological governance, and emerging photovoltaic energy sectors. Major projects are concentrated in Anhui province and other regions across China, with some overseas sales in Europe, America, and the Middle East.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with a strong presence in Anhui province covering cities such as Hefei, Huainan, Huaibei, Bengbu, Lu'an, Huangshan, Suzhou, Anqing, and Wuhu. It also has projects and subsidiaries in over 20 provinces and cities nationwide. Additionally, the company has established an overseas business division exporting photovoltaic equipment and installation services to Europe, America, and the Middle East.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the environmental protection supply chain, providing integrated environmental solutions including design, equipment manufacturing, project construction, and operation services. It also has upstream capabilities with its own production factories for key components, ensuring quality control and cost efficiency.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company emphasizes deepening environmental governance and solid waste resource utilization while actively expanding into new energy, new materials, semiconductor, artificial intelligence, and zero/negative carbon technologies. It invests heavily in R&D, maintaining national and provincial technology centers, and collaborates with universities for innovation. Key R&D projects include CO2 capture and conversion, sludge carbonization, landfill pollution control, and advanced wastewater treatment technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through project-based sales of environmental overall solutions, including engineering construction contracts, equipment sales, and operation services under BOT, BOO, and entrusted operation models. The company also earns income from photovoltaic system sales and related services. Pricing is mainly determined through government and industry tendering processes.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in China's ecological protection and environmental governance industry, particularly in solid waste and water pollution treatment sectors. It holds a strong competitive position in Anhui province and has national recognition with multiple industry awards. Competitors include large state-owned enterprises and other specialized environmental technology firms, but Tongyuan Environment distinguishes itself through integrated solutions and proprietary technologies.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.6 billion, a 7.35% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 21.75 million, down 31.45% mainly due to increased bad debt provisions. Total assets reached RMB 3.09 billion, growing 12.16%. The company maintains positive operating cash flow and continues to invest in R&D, with a 3.02% R&D-to-revenue ratio. It has a stable shareholder base with over 3,000 shareholders and a market capitalization reflecting its mid-sized status.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers comprehensive, customized environmental solutions integrating advanced proprietary technologies and full lifecycle services from design to operation. Its unique value lies in its strong R&D capabilities, patented technologies in pollution control and resource recovery, and its ability to deliver high-quality, cost-effective projects with sustainable environmental impact. The integration of environmental protection with emerging sectors like photovoltaic energy and carbon capture positions it as a forward-looking, innovative leader in the green economy.
